component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.assets.share
component.documentation: Share links: an asset's picture views, and its original where its rights allow, given to someone who is not signed in, through /nuxeo/agentic-share/ and a token of 256 bits, of which the server keeps the SHA-256 only. A link is bound to one document, the items it lists and its last day, in UTC. It opens only while it is not revoked and not past that day, its creator still holds WriteSecurity on the document, and the document's rights policy (org.nuxeo.agentic.assets.rights) allows each item, with the asset's rights not ended, previews included. Every byte it serves is watermarked here, and every download is logged, with the time, the link and the item only.
